selectionRule: value = production-fit + reuse + maintenance - duplication - runtime-cost; assign one implementation owner per capability: product integration in Aphrody, runtime and SDK in Bun, shared UI in Material, distribution assembly in Bun OS, host policy in Aphrody Infra, and Debian APT sources in its fork

repositories.role: Aphrody product workflows and integration: native CLI, browser and desktop surfaces, application delivery, and Infra desired-state catalogs. Imported capability owners retain runtime, SDK, shared UI, distribution and package-manager implementation.
repositories.note: Product integration repository; runtime, UI framework, distribution and Debian APT sources stay with their named capability owners.

repositories.role: Bun runtime and SDK: JavaScriptCore/WebKit, built-ins, package manager, system APIs, native integrations and Bun Cloudflare capabilities. Runtime source changes belong to upstream oven-sh/bun; product configuration and release orchestration stay with Aphrody Infra.
repositories.note: Canonical runtime and system SDK owner; produces SDK artifacts consumed by Bun OS and served from bun-lib.aphrody.app. Infra owns DNS and R2 state. Resolve the checkout from workspace configuration.

repositories.role: Material 3 framework: native tokens, shared controls, libm3, WASM adapters and shared app UI packages. Aphrody and Bun consume pinned Material owners without duplicating framework implementation.
repositories.note: Canonical Material 3, libm3, tokens, controls, WASM adapters and shared app-ui source owner.

repositories.role: Debian APT source fork and package manager implementation. Bun OS owns distribution integration and cross-ecosystem package conversion.
repositories.note: Retains official Debian APT history and package identity.
